data.name: DeltaPatterns_Description
data.value: Classifies a rolling window of the last N traded contracts into delta patterns (aggressive, dominance, divergence, reversal, neutral) with price-chart markers and alerts.

data.name: Aggressive_Description
data.value: Net delta of the window beyond Min Delta % of the target volume.

data.name: Dominance_Description
data.value: One-sided delta beyond Min Delta % whose running delta never went against it by more than Wick Tolerance % (both as % of the target volume).

data.name: Divergence_Description
data.value: The window closed in one price direction while its net delta, beyond Min Delta %, points the other way. A window that closes at its open is never a divergence.

data.name: Reversal_Description
data.value: The running delta reached Min Delta % on one side and the window closed beyond Close Min % on the other.

data.name: Neutral_Description
data.value: Small net delta (at most Min Delta % of the window volume) after the running delta went far to one side (at least Struggle % of the target volume): both sides fought and nobody won.

data.name: Normal_Description
data.value: Colour of the windows that match no other pattern. Only Visible and Colour apply.

data.name: TargetVolume_Description
data.value: Size of the rolling window in contracts: each bar shows the state of the last N traded contracts. The pattern thresholds are percentages of this value.

data.name: SessionsToCalculate_Description
data.value: Number of the most recent sessions whose trades are requested and classified. 0 calculates the whole chart, which can take long with many days loaded.

data.name: ShowChartSignals_Description
data.value: Draws a marker on the price chart for each bar with a visible pattern.

data.name: SignalSize_Description
data.value: Size of the markers in pixels (2 to 50).

data.name: AlertSoundFile_Description
data.value: Sound file ATAS plays when an alert fires.

data.name: AlertCooldownSeconds_Description
data.value: Minimum time between two alerts, shared by all the patterns.

data.name: AlertBackgroundColor_Description
data.value: Background colour of the alert pop-up.

data.name: AlertForegroundColor_Description
data.value: Text colour of the alert pop-up.

data.name: OverlayMode_Description
data.value: Status panel on the price chart. Compact shows the rolling window and the live pattern; Full adds the chart-wide statistics, the alert cooldown and the flags of each pattern.

data.name: OverlayCorner_Description
data.value: Corner of the price chart where the status panel is drawn.

data.name: OverlayOffsetX_Description
data.value: Horizontal offset of the status panel in pixels. Positive moves it right.

data.name: OverlayOffsetY_Description
data.value: Vertical offset of the status panel in pixels. Positive moves it down.

data.name: Category_Enabled_Description
data.value: Detect this pattern. When off, the windows fall through to the next pattern of the chain (divergence, reversal, dominance, aggressive, neutral).

data.name: Category_Visible_Description
data.value: Draw this pattern in the panel and on the price chart. A hidden pattern is still detected and can still alert.

data.name: Category_MinDeltaPercent_Description
data.value: Delta threshold as a percentage of the target volume (for Neutral, the maximum net delta as a percentage of the window volume).

data.name: Category_EnableAlert_Description
data.value: Alert in realtime when the live window changes to this pattern.

data.name: Category_BuyColor_Description
data.value: Colour of the buying side of the pattern.

data.name: Category_SellColor_Description
data.value: Colour of the selling side of the pattern.

data.name: Category_WickTolerancePercent_Description
data.value: Largest move of the running delta against the dominant side, as a percentage of the target volume.

data.name: Category_ClosePercent_Description
data.value: Net delta the window must close with on the opposite side, as a percentage of the target volume.

data.name: Category_StrugglePercent_Description
data.value: How far the running delta must have gone to either side, as a percentage of the target volume.

data.name: ScaleLimit_Description
data.value: Upper limit of the panel scale in contracts of delta. 0 scales to the largest window of the calculated range, so a single outlier can flatten the rest; with a limit the usual bars stay readable and the outliers go off the panel.
